content: QuPath 0.6.0 core (not the BraiAn extension) supports fully scriptable pixel classification: PixelClassifiers.createThreshold(resolution, channel, threshold, belowClass, aboveClass) builds a single-channel intensity threshold classifier without any GUI training step. qupath.opencv.ml.pixel.PixelClassifierTools.createMeasurementManager(imageData, classifier) + addMeasurementsToSelectedObjects() attaches %-positive-area measurements directly to existing selected objects (e.g. the ABBA atlas-region annotations already in the hierarchy) -- this is the direct API path for an area-over-DAPI density readout in compact-nuclei regions, fully scriptable and reusable brain-wide.
